_what: Post #1 (TikTok 7167399325910289706) planned automatically, compared with the hand-made Asset 01 spec, and the prompt changes that closed the gaps. Rendered on the Ad Variations page, 'Against the hand-made spec'.
summary: The first prompts found the elements and the corpus numbers, but locked too much, bundled several changes into one variation and read the sound wrong. Three passes later the automatic plan covers seven of the hand spec's ten levers (not the problem line, the demo bodies or the pitcher swap) with the same structure (a paid base plus one-lever variations, cast from the roster), finds the music bed and the reveal hit, and finds post #3 as the same template. What it still cannot do is see the frames: the picture for each beat comes from the teardown record, so it cannot spot reused footage the way the hand spec did.
